My work sits at the intersection of computational text analysis and empirical finance, with a growing strand on how generative AI changes management education. Full records: [Google Scholar](https://scholar.google.co.in/citations?user=m9SYPDMAAAAJ) · [ORCID](https://orcid.org/0000-0001-5740-0804) · [Scopus](https://www.scopus.com/authid/detail.uri?authorId=57214111533) · [BibTeX](publications.bib).
